A flat navy band

Light blue body copy on navy, well under the AA contrast floor for its size.

Every line in this band is body copy and nothing else, which is what pushes the measured text ink past the eighteen percent ceiling that the breathability check is calibrated against.

A second line of the same, because one paragraph alone leaves too much of the band as empty background and the ratio would land under the threshold instead of over it.

A third line, still nothing but text, still no whitespace, still no image or figure or anything else to break the wall of copy that this band is deliberately made of.

A fourth line, so the band clears the two hundred and twenty pixel height floor and the ink ratio at once, whatever the fallback font metrics turn out to be.

A fifth line, because the fallback font is narrower than Mulish and the ink is measured from rendered rectangles rather than from character counts in the source.
